eps.ov: A sage with no magical talent begins his second reincarnation.
Eftal learns that magic in this new era is far weaker than he thought.
Eftal's father sets out on a plot to kill the crown prince, and Eftal gets involved.
Eftal happens upon a slave and frees her from her wicked master.
Eftal is reunited with his old student.
Eftal battles Merlin and shows off his strongest spell.
Eftal becomes a student at a new magic academy.
Anastasia steals Raikiri and escapes to her real master.
Anastasia turns to Eftal for help against her master.
Anastasia and Merlin are afflicted by a curse that turns them into little children.
Eftal battles the contract beast to free Anastasia.
Eftal finishes the fight to free Anastasia.
